role: District Representative · Nueva Vizcaya, Lone District
summary: Nueva Vizcaya representative with 200 principal-authored bills. Authored the national minimum wage, a government PERA increase, higher tax-exempt income thresholds and a tax code amendment; co-authored suspension of petroleum excise during emergencies. Evidence is limited to economic policy.
caveat: Economic-only evidence; direction of HB05207 not reviewed. No votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored national minimum wage (-2) and PERA increase for government personnel (-2); tax relief via higher exempt income (-1) offset by co-authored fuel-excise suspension (+1).
